promptZh: What do most experts think of drone delivery? 根据短文内容，选择最佳答案。

explanation.summaryZh: 多数专家认为随着技术更便宜、更安全，无人机将成为医疗保健的常规部分。
explanation.ruleZh: 主旨题：抓住首尾段和反复出现的关键词，选择能概括全文大意的选项。

evidence.quote: drones will quietly become a normal part of health care

options.text: It should be stopped because of the noise.
It works only in fine weather.
It is too expensive to develop.
